text: 【国常会最新部署！你的公积金 将有新变化】国务院常务会议7月31日审议通过《国务院关于修改〈住房公积金管理条例〉的决定（草案）》。条例草案要求要更好发挥住房公积金功能作用，拓宽提取和使用范围，扩大制度覆盖面，提升管理服务效能，更好满足居民多样化住房消费需求。
text_en: [New deployment from the State Council executive meeting! Your housing provident fund will see new changes] The State Council executive meeting on July 31 reviewed and approved the "State Council Decision on Amending the Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Funds (Draft)." The draft requires better leveraging the role of housing provident funds, expanding the scope of withdrawals and uses, broadening system coverage, improving management service efficiency, and better meeting residents' diverse housing consumption needs.
